name: happyhorse-1.0-i2v
description: HappyHorse 1.0 I2V is an image-to-video generation model designed to animate static images while preserving their original structure, color style, composition, and visual details. It can infer natural motion from image content and generate temporally coherent videos without disrupting the source image’s visual identity. The model is especially suitable for product image animation, e-commerce short video production, concept visualization, and creative image-based storytelling.
zhDescription: happyhorse-1.0-i2v 是面向图像生成视频的专业模型，能够基于静态图片生成自然、连贯的动态视频。模型在图像结构、色彩风格、细节纹理和构图保持方面表现突出，可在不破坏原图视觉特征的前提下补充合理运动效果，适合电商主图转视频、商品展示、艺术创作、概念设计可视化和图片动态化生产场景。
